Introduction

Why this strategy exists, and the people who shaped it.

About this strategy

The strategy behind every Matal story.

Matal is a specialist children’s brand built on a holistic view of content, products and services for children. Its strategy and identity focus on Iranian children growing up outside Iran, with stories and storytelling at the centre and a strong emphasis on the Persian language and Iranian culture.

The strategy team

The people who shaped this strategy.

Business Strategy

Where Matal is heading, what it offers, and who it serves.

One ecosystem, two brands

Moj the Storyteller and Matal share one dream.

Matal is the commercial brand within the Moj & Matal ecosystem, created to teach the Persian language and Iranian culture to Iranian children living outside Iran. Both brands share the same vision and the same ambitions of their founders.

03

Brand Architecture

How the Matal family stays one clear brand as it grows.

Global models

Planning the family before it grows.

Brand architecture defines how a parent brand relates to its sub-brands, so every new line can join the family without confusing anyone.

Matal’s architecture · dynamic branded house

One name. Many lines.

Each future product line is told apart by colour and a simple descriptor. The name Matal never changes.

⭐ Until the range grows, the master logo alone carries every product. Descriptors are introduced line by line, only when needed.

Brand Conceptual Identity

What Matal gives, what it stands for, and the character it speaks with.

Value ladders

From what we make, to how it feels.

Each ladder climbs from visible features, to practical benefits, to feelings, and ends in one end value.

Brand essence
Reimagining Children’s Stories with Wonder & Curiosity

By creating and reimagining children’s stories, Matal fills the world of childhood with imagination, warmth and curiosity.

Brand positioning

Where Matal stands.

Brand promise
A high-quality Iranian children’s brand that creates engaging content, story-based products and experiences, by imaginatively creating and reimagining stories.

By keeping story, imagination and a warm, hopeful outlook alive, Matal builds a richer, more meaningful world for Iranian children and families.

Brand personality · Aaker’s model

Sincere and family-centred, with a spark of excitement.

If Matal were a person, who would it be? We answer with Jennifer Aaker’s five dimensions, and with brand archetypes.

Brand archetypes

Twelve characters. Three that are us.

After Carl Jung, and Margaret Mark & Carol S. Pearson’s The Hero and the Outlaw: twelve archetypes on two axes, stability or change, belonging or independence.
